# Selected external model inventory

Acquired 2026-09-10. All items are CC0; creator and rights records are in [catalog.json](catalog.json). Sizes include each source's dependencies; shared files repeat across rows but are stored once. Triangles are counts in the default glTF scene. These are acquisition measurements. See [USAGE-GUIDE.md](USAGE-GUIDE.md) and [runtime-catalog.json](runtime-catalog.json) for current published derivatives and integration status.
